snippet.title: War of the Zombie - Official Trailer 1 for iPad / iPhone
snippet.description:
Out now for android on Google play store, iOS on the App Store and as of March 2018 MAC OS on the Mac App Store. War of the Zombie is a new Zombie Outbreak strategy simulation.

"A juicy display of a game." - TouchArcade.com

"Not like most other zombie games." - Kotaku.com

"A hell of a World War Z game." - PocketTactics.com

"A ton of depth & cool gameplay." - ipadblogs.nl

"Fresh air in the zombie genre." - 9lives.be

"Extremely promising." - Apperama.com

Become a fan and be informed about the game's launch at http://www.facebook.com/vdvgames

War of the Zombie MAC OS:
https://itunes.apple.com/app/war-of-the-zombie/id1348748052

War of the Zombie Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vanderveergames.wotz

War of the Zombie IOS:
https://itunes.apple.com/app/war-of-the-zombie/id605277717
